prompt: Create a premium abstract background and lighting layer for a macOS productivity app App Store screenshot gallery. Bright light-mode atmosphere: warm ivory paper, very subtle apricot and amber glow, a restrained hint of soft lilac, translucent frosted-glass curves, gentle depth and refined natural shadows. Calm, focused, native-to-macOS sensibility. Landscape 16:10 composition with generous clean negative space, especially across the upper third. No text, no letters, no logos, no icons, no UI, no device mockups, no screenshots, no charts, no numbers, no product claims, no watermarks. This is only a background polish layer for deterministic product screenshots and exact typography to be composited later.
title: Light frosted native polish
